clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial single-member only. US-001 is a hard GO/NO-GO gate that confirms the codex collab-disable surface before any wiring; US-002..US-006 all converge on the same plugin's 6 version stamps, AGENTS.md, CHANGELOG, and mechanically-regenerated .copilot-plugin/.codex-plugin artifact trees, so parallelizing them produces conflicting writes. Same-plugin parallel = conflict per the disjoint-surface rule. A config-disable NO-GO ends this job; the codex fork patch is a SEPARATE single-repo codex plan (dual-repo rule), never chained here.
